name: Story Mode
author: Paycei
description: A game mode with a story, launched from MODS.EXE > Game Modes: an opening cutscene, dialogue with a portrait, a blessing to choose, a choice at wave 5 that changes the run, its own HUD card and a pause-menu action. Shows ui.cutscene, ui.dialogue, ui.choose, register.hudCard and register.pauseAction.
